additional_info.subject: RE: AUTORECHARGE &  SIEMENS France
additional_info.body:
Hello,
As we approach the end of 2024, while you may be enjoying precious moments with your families, our clients are facing increased challenges due to recurring issues with several SICharge charging stations. These problems are directly impacting their ability to meet their commitments to their own customers. Here are the details:
SICharge Station
- Serial No.
D MP/R6 170002001
After a restart, no feedback appeared on our backend, leaving us unable to determine its current status.
SICharge Station
- Serial No.
D Y2/S2 313518164001
One CCS2 connector is faulty.
A restart was performed, but the station remains offline with no feedback visible on our backend.
SICharge Station
- Serial No.
D MPR8170002535
Same issue: one CCS2 connector is faulty.
To avoid further complications, this station has not been restarted.
We kindly request:
A detailed analysis of the logs for the affected stations on
12/31/2024
, between
8:00 AM and 1:00 PM
.
A thorough explanation of the root causes of these recurring incidents, as they are damaging your reputation and affecting our collaboration.
Immediate corrective actions and a plan to anticipate client complaints and inquiries.
Clear visibility into planned corrective updates for these devices.
We take this opportunity to wish you a happy and prosperous New Year in 2025, with a strong start that reflects the professionalism of those who prioritize their customers and address such issues with the seriousness they deserve.
We look forward to your prompt response and remain available for any additional information you may require.
Best regards,

Good morning gentlemen,
I am writing to express our concern regarding the delay on implementation of the wake-up functionality for our customers. This functionality missing has a direct impact on our ability to meet their needs, especially during winter time as expressed by Malek below, and this since almost two years now. During our exchanges it was indicated the function would be available by June of this year. Then it was delayed again by a need of testing, which was carried out this summer and seems to have worked then. We were informed supplementary tests were successfully taken recently in Sweden. We are now waiting news on a patch roll-out.
We have been keeping our customers patient but we now need to communicate a clear implementation date of the wake up functionality.
We therefore would appreciate an urgent update on the status of the implementation, along with a timeline for completion.
Thank you for your attention to this matter. We look forward to your prompt response
Regards

additional_info.subject: 0397690 - ID0397690-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / R6 170002001] Multiple issues CRM:00568000153
additional_info.body:
Hello,
After the intervention today from Malek on site and the support from myside and a collegue of Malek, the rootcause has been identified and was due to the “ boot loader issue" on the router.
After to reflash it with this specific procedure, the router is now functionnal and the charger is also functionnal.
1. Débranchez l'alimentation du routeur et laissez uniquement le port Ethernet LAN connecté à votre ordinateur. Ne branchez pas      le port WAN.
2. Appuyez sur le bouton Reset, puis rebranchez l'alimentation tout en maintenant le bouton Reset pendant 3-4 secondes. Les           voyants Ethernet doivent clignoter.
3. Ouvrez votre navigateur et accédez à l'adresse 192.168.1.1/uboot.html. Si cela ne fonctionne pas, videz le cache du navigateur       ou utilisez le mode privé/incognito.
Chargez l’image Bootloader et cliquez sur Update U-Boot.
We're waiting the go from the customer to update the charger from 4.0.11 to 6.0.3 to improve the charger .
